description:
Early viewing is recommended for this spacious home with pleasant outlook over parkland. Being sold with long term tenant already in situ and available with no onwards chain, this property is also situated close to local amenities and the town centre and is ideal for landlords and investors. The property is accessed via pathway to the rear. The entry door opens into a reception hallway. There is a downstairs w/c and access to the main living/dining room and kitchen. The living/dining room has patio doors to the rear and the kitchen is a good size and with fitted units. To the first floor there is a landing area, three bedrooms and bathroom. Outside to the front the property has small enclosed garden area and overlooks parkland. There is an enclosed rear garden which with pathway and rear access gate.

RECEPTION HALLWAY With staircase to the first floor.

DOWNSTAIRS W/C With sink and toilet.

LIVING/DINING ROOM Great sized reception room with French doors and window to the rear.

KITCHEN With fitted units, worktops, tiled splashbacks, cooker hood, space for appliances, sink unit and window to rear.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING Access to upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Double room with window to the front.

BEDROOM TWO Double room with window to the front.

BEDROOM THREE Single room with window to the rear.

BATHROOM Partially tiled with window to the rear and suite comprising bath with overhead shower, toilet and sink.

EXTERNALLY Outside to the front the property has small enclosed garden area and overlooks parkland. There is an enclosed rear garden which with pathway and rear access gate.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
